name: Night Grimoire
author: Heart of Magic
description: A spellbook read by night: deep indigo vellum, gold-leaf ink, chapter titles, and the tree spreading out in gold when it opens.

descriptions.ko: 밤에 읽는 마법서: 짙은 남색 양피지, 금박 잉크, 장 제목, 그리고 열 때 금빛으로 번지며 드러나는 트리.
descriptions.de: Ein Zauberbuch bei Nacht: tiefblaues Pergament, Blattgold-Tinte, Kapitelüberschriften, und der Baum breitet sich beim Öffnen golden aus.
descriptions.es: Un grimorio leído de noche: vitela índigo, tinta de pan de oro, títulos de capítulo y el árbol que se extiende en oro al abrirlo.
descriptions.fr: Un grimoire lu de nuit : vélin indigo, encre à la feuille d'or, titres de chapitre, et l'arbre qui se répand en or à l'ouverture.
descriptions.it: Un grimorio letto di notte: pergamena indaco, inchiostro in foglia d'oro, titoli dei capitoli e l'albero che si espande in oro all'apertura.
descriptions.ja: 夜に読む魔法書：深い藍色の羊皮紙、金箔のインク、章題、そして開くと金色に広がるツリー。
descriptions.pl: Księga zaklęć czytana nocą: indygowy welin, atrament ze złota, tytuły rozdziałów, a drzewo rozlewa się złotem po otwarciu.
descriptions.pt-br: Um grimório lido à noite: velino índigo, tinta de folha de ouro, títulos de capítulo e a árvore que se espalha em ouro ao abrir.
descriptions.ru: Книга заклинаний для ночного чтения: тёмно-синий пергамент, чернила сусального золота, заголовки глав, и дерево растекается золотом при открытии.
descriptions.tr: Gece okunan bir büyü kitabı: koyu çivit parşömen, altın varak mürekkep, bölüm başlıkları ve açılınca altın gibi yayılan ağaç.
descriptions.zh-cn: 夜读的魔法书：深靛色羊皮纸、金箔墨水、章节标题，打开时法术树以金色晕染开来。
descriptions.zh-tw: 夜讀的魔法書：深靛色羊皮紙、金箔墨水、章節標題，打開時法術樹以金色暈染開來。

css: /* No tree yet: the indigo page itself, with an engraved book and star in gold (themes/nightgrimoire/empty.png) */
.empty-icon { width: 360px; height: 240px; max-width: 80%; font-size: 0; opacity: 1; margin-bottom: 6px;
/* Engraved inscription capitals for titles (Cinzel; its Cyrillic from Alegreya SC) and a printed
book face for the text (Literata), with each language's own book face behind it (themes/fonts/book,
OFL, see README.txt there). A face is only loaded when text uses it. */
@font-face { font-family: "HoM Book Body"; font-weight: bold; src: url("themes/fonts/book/book-body-latin-bold.ttf"); }
@font-face { font-family: "HoM Book Title NG Cyrillic"; src: url("themes/fonts/book/book-title-ng-cyrillic.ttf"); }
--ng-title: "HoM Book Title NG", "HoM Book Title NG Cyrillic", "HoM Book Title Arcane", "HoM Book Body", Georgia, serif;
html:lang(ko) { --ng-body: "HoM Book Body", "HoM Book Body KO", "Batang", serif;
--ng-title: "HoM Book Title NG", "HoM Book Title NG Cyrillic", "HoM Book Title Arcane", "HoM Book Body", "HoM Book Body KO", "Batang", serif; }
html:lang(ja) { --ng-body: "HoM Book Body", "HoM Book Body JA", "Yu Mincho", serif;
--ng-title: "HoM Book Title NG", "HoM Book Title NG Cyrillic", "HoM Book Title Arcane", "HoM Book Body", "HoM Book Body JA", "Yu Mincho", serif; }
html:lang(zh-cn) { --ng-body: "HoM Book Body", "HoM Book Body SC", "SimSun", serif;
--ng-title: "HoM Book Title NG", "HoM Book Title NG Cyrillic", "HoM Book Title Arcane", "HoM Book Body", "HoM Book Body SC", "SimSun", serif; }
html:lang(zh-tw) { --ng-body: "HoM Book Body", "HoM Book Body TC", "MingLiU", serif;
--ng-title: "HoM Book Title NG", "HoM Book Title NG Cyrillic", "HoM Book Title Arcane", "HoM Book Body", "HoM Book Body TC", "MingLiU", serif; }
body, button, input, select, textarea, .btn { font-family: var(--ng-body); }
